ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: A 2020-digit number N satisfies 10^2019 <= N < 10^2020. Squaring gives N^2 < 10^4040, so the square can have at most 4040 digits. The condition that the last two digits are 99 does not lower this maximum, because N = 10^2020 - 1 is a 2020-digit number made entirely of 9s, so it ends in 99. Its square is (10^2020 - 1)^2, which is less than 10^4040 but greater than or equal to 10^4039, so it has 4040 digits. Therefore the maximum possible number of digits is 4040.
